name: Store reviews
description: What customers said about the store, with their ratings.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/store-reviews", name: "Store reviews", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "What customers said about the store, with their ratings.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Row(gap: Space.sm, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
        Text(child: "Reviews", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold),
        If(condition: store.rating_count > 0, then: Badge(label: "${store.rating} · ${store.rating_count} ratings", tone: Tone.neutral))
      ]),
      ForEach(items: options.reviews, as: "r", limit: 5, empty: Text(child: "No reviews yet.", color: Color.textMuted), child: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [
        Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: r.customer_name, weight: FontWeight.semibold)), If(condition: r.food_rating, then: Text(child: "${r.food_rating}/5", weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primary))]),
        If(condition: r.food_comment, then: Text(child: r.food_comment, color: Color.textMuted))
      ])))
    ])
  )], data: [Data(name: "store", from: Client.store(), fetch: "client", type: Store)],
options: [DataOption(name: "reviews", type: OrderReview, list: true, required: true)],
)
